title: Major Istanbul Trade Fairs 2026–2027: Calendar & Hotel Strategy

quickAnswer: Major Istanbul trade fairs in 2026 and 2027 center on three venues: Tüyap in Büyükçekmece, Istanbul Expo Center (IFM) in Yeşilköy, and Istanbul Congress Center (ICC) in Harbiye. Nearby hotel rates surge 60 to 120 days out, so foreign delegations must match lodging zones to daily hall hours and evening client dinners.
category: Business Travel, Trade Fairs & Corporate Delegations (ITO Advisory)

body.text: Which major international expos take place at Tüyap, IFM (Istanbul Expo Center) and ICC?

Istanbul's international trade calendar splits cleanly by sector and hall size across three venues. Tüyap handles heavy manufacturing, plastics, automotive aftermarket, and medical devices; IFM hosts defense, textiles, chemicals, and tourism expos; and ICC focuses on corporate congresses, diplomatic summits, and executive conferences in central Şişli.

Key dates from the [IFM Fair Calendar](https://ifm.com.tr/en/fair-calendar), [FuarVakti Istanbul 2026–2027](https://www.fuarvakti.com/en/city/istanbul/), and [XpoMatch's Tüyap 2027 calendar](https://xpomatch.net/en/blog/tuyap-istanbul-trade-fair-calendar-2027) include TURKCHEM and InterDye Eurasia (23–25 November 2026 at IFM), [Plast Eurasia](https://plasteurasia.com/e-bilet) (2–5 December 2026 at Tüyap), the [International Istanbul Furniture Fair](https://www.istanbulfurniturefair.com/en) (19–23 January 2027 across both Tüyap and IFM), Automechanika Istanbul (24–27 March 2027 at Tüyap), IDEF 2027 (3–9 May 2027 at IFM), and [BEAUTYISTANBUL](https://beauty-istanbul.com/) (3–5 June 2027 at Tüyap). [Istanbul Congress Center (ICC)](https://www.iccistanbul.com/about.php) in Harbiye hosts executive summits near Nişantaşı.
How far in advance do nearby hotels surge in price?

Hotels within 5 kilometers of Tüyap and IFM raise nightly rates 60 to 120 days before major international exhibitions, often doubling standard weekday tariffs during peak fairs such as Automechanika, IDEF, and the Furniture Fair. Early room blocks disappear first at properties adjacent to the exhibition gates.

Around IFM, hotels in Bakırköy, Ataköy, and Basın Ekspres fill first for their 10-minute commute. At Tüyap, limited four- and five-star stock in Büyükçekmece and Beylikdüzü sells out even faster. Overlapping multi-venue weeks—such as the January 2027 Furniture Fair—push rates up across Şişli and Beşiktaş, making refundable blocks 90 days ahead essential.
Should you stay near the fairground or in central Istanbul with a private driver?

Stay near the fairground if your team manages a booth and needs early morning hall access for setup and freight checks. Stay in central Istanbul—such as Nişantaşı, Beşiktaş, or Karaköy—with a pre-booked private driver if you are visiting buyers who host evening client dinners.

Geography drives this decision. Tüyap sits roughly 35 kilometers west of Taksim along the E-5 highway, where morning and evening rush-hour drives easily stretch to 75–100 minutes each way. IFM in Yeşilköy is closer—about 20 to 30 minutes from the Bosphorus shoreline outside peak hours, and directly connected to the M1A metro line. For delegations combining hall visits with factory tours or executive meetings, review our guide to [corporate delegation logistics in Istanbul](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/corporate-delegation-istanbul) to balance vehicle classes and buffer times.

body.text: How do you plan evening client dinners around fair hours?

Most Istanbul trade fairs close their exhibition halls between 17:00 and 18:00, which coincides with peak westbound and eastbound commuter traffic. Plan client dinners for 20:00 or 20:30, giving guests a realistic 90-minute transfer window to leave the fairground, freshen up, and reach central dining districts.

Avoid 19:00 Bosphorus bookings if leaving Tüyap at 18:00; E-5 gridlock guarantees late arrivals. For IFM days, Yeşilköy marina or Bakırköy venues allow a 19:30 start without city crossings. For formal Bosphorus dinners, exit halls by 16:45 and review our [Turkish business etiquette](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/turkish-business-etiquette) guide.

faq.q: Which Istanbul airport is closer to Tüyap and IFM?
faq.a: Istanbul Airport (IST) is closest to both Tüyap (35–50 minutes via the Northern Marmara Motorway) and IFM (40–55 minutes). Sabiha Gökçen (SAW) adds a Bosphorus crossing during weekday peaks.

faq.q: Can visitors reach IFM or Tüyap by public transit from central Istanbul?
faq.a: Yes. IFM links to the M1A metro (DTM–İstanbul Fuar Merkezi), while Tüyap sits at the Metrobüs western terminus. Heavy peak crowds make private transfers more reliable for executives.

faq.q: When do major 2026–2027 fairs overlap across Tüyap and IFM?
faq.a: The International Istanbul Furniture Fair (19–23 January 2027) runs concurrently across both Tüyap and IFM. Always verify which venue houses your specific suppliers before booking hotels or freight deliveries.

faq.q: How much buffer time should I add between Tüyap and central Istanbul?
faq.a: Allow 75 to 100 minutes during weekday peaks (07:30–09:30 and 17:00–20:00), and 45 to 60 minutes midday.

faq.q: Do Istanbul trade fair hotels require non-refundable deposits?
faq.a: During flagship expos like Automechanika or IDEF, many fairground-adjacent hotels switch to strict prepayment terms 45 to 60 days prior. Early booking preserves flexible cancellation windows.
